name: marketborn-root
description: Marketborn workspace orchestration: quality gates and app scripts

scripts.check: npm run check:fmt && npm run build:app && npm run check:clippy && npm run check:cargo-test && npm run check:ts && npm run check:vitest
scripts.check:full: npm run check && cargo test --workspace --release -- --include-ignored && npm run e2e
scripts.e2e: cargo build --release -p sim-cli && npm --prefix app run e2e
scripts.app:desktop: npm run build:app && cargo run -p marketborn
scripts.app:package: npm run build:app && npm --prefix app exec -- tauri build
